author: Mike C
text: I called Rod to locate and uncover my septic tank after a blockage. He came right out, found and uncovered the Septic, and made some other modifications I asked for. Excellent to work with! Very straight forward, and when he quoyes a price, he sticks to it.

author: Bob Murphy
text: Rod did a Fantastic job for us. He was here quick knew exactly what to do and got our toilets working again and VERY REASONABLY priced I would recommend him to any one and I WILL use him again if needed

author: Marquis Edward
text: Called to see if he could assist with an emergency fix, once he found out it was under the house in a crawl space, he said he was book and good luck finding someone to help.

author: Kaitlyn Raney
text: I so appreciated the quick response and knowledgeable help when an outdoor pipe began leaking in our rental. Living out of state can make emergency home repairs very challenging. I called Rod this morning and he was working away within the hour.  I am very  pleased with the quality of work that was done, appreciate the communication that I received as I was not physically there to oversee the work being done, and am blown away by the incredibly reasonable pricing. I know who to call should we ever need repairs done again!

author: Courtney Rowley
text: Rod is amazing! He saved me twice in the same morning! And with 2 separate leaks and visits. He's quick, personable, professional, knowledgeable and very reasonably priced. You could tell he was willing to help and was concerned for my issue. I love that! I'm so happy I found him and called him. Would highly recommend him!!
